$comment: Registry of the webview panels the visual harness renders.
Each entry mirrors one panel's HTML shell in vscode-extension/src/extension.ts:
bundle  — the esbuild entry point name in esbuild.js (dist/webview/<bundle>.js)
global  — the window global that shell assigns the view's data to
fixture — a JSON file in ./fixtures holding that data
To add a view: add its esbuild entry point name here, capture the data its
shell passes (the __INITIAL_*__ payload) into a fixture, and run
`node render-views.js --view <id>` to check it renders.
scenarios: optional scripted click/select flows replayed by
scripts/interaction-smoke.js. The one-pass control crawl cannot change a
<select> or reach a control that only appears after another one was used,
so a view declares those flows here: each step is a `click` or a `select`
(with an optional `value`; otherwise the next enabled option is taken), and
`expect` is a selector the view must still be showing after every step.
noiseFloorPixels: how many differing pixels count as run-to-run noise
rather than a real change. Only views that draw to a <canvas> need it —
anti-aliasing there is not perfectly reproducible. Omit it (default 0) so
DOM-rendered views are compared exactly.
